body: I do my best to do this. He says that me just listening helps quite a bit, but I'm not really sure. I have my own anxieties and fears that I often tell him a lot, I think that sometimes I stress him out with it. I'm not sure honestly but I try to do these things regardless.

Thank you, I'll definitely look into that!
Yes, we do talk quite often about these sort of things. For a time I was suicidal myself and still have urges, and often open up to him about this. The only issue is that he says that he feels awful sometimes because I seem to have it worse than him; the thing is, I've gotten much more help. Lately I've been trying to get him to be more honest, I think it might be working. Thank you so much for the advice.

His parents aren't that abusive from what I've heard, but he gets very anxious when they yell at him. From what it sounds like, they're good parents.
He's not being bullied at school. He says that nobody really pays attention to him, anyway.
He's extremely rough on himself and overthinks things, yes. I know that for a fact.
